correctness.rationale: For a maximizing opposite-support pair A,B at u, D=A-B satisfies <D,u>=w_K(u) and its tangential norm is exactly p_K(u). The great-circle perturbation toward that tangential component gives w_K(v_t)>=w_K(u)cos(t)+p_K(u)sin(t), hence local slope at least p_K(u). The inspected Proposition 4.4 gives the reverse inequality. The global identity follows at a maximizer of the upper-semicontinuous p_K. The proof covers nonunique support faces and p_K=0.
